title: Meet the REGENT crew
summary: Join the team building the future of maritime mobility.
body_markdown:
This is what the future of maritime innovation looks like. Meet the REGENT **** crew, the people behind the build, challenging the way we think about transportation and propelling us into the next generation of maritime manufacturing.


Explore[open careers here](https://www.regentcraft.com/careers) .


And if you can’t find a role on our[Careers page](https://www.regentcraft.com/careers#open-positions) , feel free to sign up to be a part of our[Talent Community](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/REGENT/form/interested-in-working-at-regent) .
